items.exampleEn: This area is very quiet at night.
Today is a national holiday, so the banks are closed.
items.exampleZh: 今天是國定假日，所以銀行沒有開。

items.exampleEn: This sport is popular in many nations.
items.exampleZh: 這項運動在很多國家都很受歡迎。

items.exampleEn: We ate at a local restaurant.
items.exampleZh: 我們在一家當地的餐廳吃飯。

items.exampleEn: This is an international school, so students come from many countries.
items.exampleZh: 這是一所國際學校，學生來自很多國家。

items.exampleEn: From this position, we can see the whole city.
items.exampleZh: 從這個位置，我們可以看到整座城市。

items.exampleEn: I need more space for my books.
Put the flowers in the center of the table.
items.exampleZh: 把花放在桌子的正中間。

items.exampleEn: The wind is coming from the north.

items.sentenceEn: People from every nation come to this festival.
items.sentenceZh: 來自各國的人都會來參加這個節慶。

items.audioEn: Our hotel is in the north of the city, near the station.
items.audioZh: 我們的旅館在城市北邊，靠近車站。

items.sentenceEn: I like to try local food when I travel.
items.sentenceZh: 我旅行時喜歡嘗試當地的食物。

items.sentenceEn: What is your position on the team?

items.stemEn: Keelung is in the ____ of Taiwan.
We should buy fruit from ____ farmers.
items.stemZh: 我們應該向本地農夫買水果。

items.passageEn: Taiwan is a small island, but it has a lot to see. In the north, Taipei is a big international city. In the center of the island, there are high mountains. Every area has its own local food. The national parks are beautiful, and there are many places for hiking.
items.passageZh: 台灣是座小島，但有很多值得看的東西。北部的台北是一座國際大城市。島的中央有高山。每個地區都有自己的在地美食。國家公園很漂亮，也有很多地方可以健行。

items.promptZh: 這間教室沒有足夠的空間。
referenceEn: There isn't enough space in this classroom.
This classroom doesn't have enough space.
rubricZh: 「沒有足夠的」可寫例如 isn't enough、doesn't have enough

items.instructionZh: 用 local 造一個句子，介紹你家附近一個在地的地方或店。
referenceEn: The local market in my town is very busy.
Our local park has a big pool.
rubricZh: local 放在名詞前，表示「當地的；本地的」（例如 the local market）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 Our local park has）
